base: No virtual table (live +0 is an entity handle); plain C++ object stored behind the component pointer.

fields.name: Entity
fields.evidence: The effect's own entity: game bg3.exe+0x2D665F0 passes *param_2 as the entity to CreateEffect (bg3.exe+0x2D66670 ~ esv::EffectManager::CreateEffect), which creates one when it is null. Live: entity handles.

fields.name: Peers
fields.evidence: esv::Effect::AddPeer / HasPeer / RemovePeer (EoCServer.dll+0x51AF50, +0x51CC10) push and search ls::TypeWrap<int, net::PeerIDClassname> values in the array at this+8 (capacity +0x10, size +0x14). Live: heap pointer, size 0/1.

fields.name: field_18
fields.evidence: Set to 1 together with +0x1B by the play-and-forget wrappers (game bg3.exe+0x2D664E0, bg3.exe+0x2D66550; Toolkit esv::EffectManager::PlayAndForgetEffect). Live 0/1.

fields.name: Looping
fields.evidence: CreateEffect copies a byte of the EffectResource (+0xA0 in the game, +0xF0 Toolkit) here; Toolkit PlayEffect warns 'Trying to play a looping effect ... not a looping one' when it is 0.

fields.name: Forget
fields.evidence: CreateEffect sets it to !Looping; PlayAndForgetEffect sets it to 1 - the effect is released by the manager when finished (name inferred).

fields.name: field_1C
fields.evidence: Live: varying bytes, never written in the functions read (maybe padding).

fields.name: field_20
fields.evidence: CreateEffect copies a 4-byte value of the EffectResource (+0x9C game, +0xEC Toolkit). Live floats 1.0-6.0 (duration?).

fields.name: Scale
fields.evidence: Float argument of PlayEffect(name, Vector3f, Quaternionf, float) stored here (Toolkit EoCServer.dll+0xCF9930, game bg3.exe+0x2D66330). Live always 1.0.

fields.name: EffectName
fields.evidence: CreateEffect assigns its FixedString name argument to +0x28 (game and Toolkit).

fields.name: Bone
fields.evidence: PlayEffect(name, EntityHandle target, FixedString) stores the third argument here (game bg3.exe+0x2D663A0 / 0x2D66550 / 0x2D665F0). Live FixedString indices or 0xFFFFFFFF.

fields.name: field_30
fields.evidence: Live: FixedString-like values or 0xFFFFFFFF; macOS default constructor stores a 4-byte constant.

fields.name: Target
fields.evidence: PlayEffect on an entity stores the target handle here (game bg3.exe+0x2D663A0, 0x2D66550, 0x2D665F0; Toolkit PlayEffectOnEntity). Live: entity handles.

fields.name: Position
fields.evidence: PlayEffect(name, Vector3f, Quaternionf, float) copies the position here (game bg3.exe+0x2D66330 / 0x2D664E0). Live zero for the entity-attached effects sampled.

fields.name: field_54
fields.evidence: Live: world-coordinate-like floats in 4 of 48 samples (43.4, 17.0, -420.8), else zero.

fields.name: Rotation
fields.evidence: PlayEffect copies the Quaternionf argument (16 bytes) here. Live (0,0,0,1).

fields.name: _Pad70
fields.evidence: Registry size 120 is 8 more than the object (0x70; the last stores of the macOS default constructor end at +0x70). Live +0x70 belongs to the next element.

open_questions: Whether the component's own storage is the object (size 120) or a pointer to it: the registry says inline 8, total 120 - handled like ecl::Item.
field_20 (float copied from the EffectResource) and field_40 (a second entity) - the Toolkit esv::Effect methods (Update / Stop) would tell.
